title: Samson's Riddle at the Wedding
description: At the wedding feast, Samson posed a riddle to his thirty companions and promised thirty linen garments and thirty festive robes to whoever solved it. The Philistines threatened Samson's wife with burning her and her father's house, so she pressured him to reveal the answer. When the men gave the answer before sunset on the seventh day, the Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson. He went down to Ashkelon, struck down thirty men, and gave their festive robes to those who had solved the riddle. His wife was given to his best man.
